name: Take My Hand
source:
A short dark fantasy toxic yuri VN about a woman imprisoned for (alleged) murder who is in a situationship with her cellmate and a sleep paralysis demon.

[From [url=https://maarika.itch.io/take-my-hand]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的黑暗幻想有毒尤里·VN，讲述了一名因（涉嫌）谋杀而入狱的妇女与她的狱友和睡眠麻痹恶魔的情况。

[来自[url=https://maarika.itch.io/take-my-hand]itch.io[/url]]
